name: Nigrescent-Armillary
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond asteroid belt proximity, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water, platinum, uranium and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
